buildCommand: npx expo export -p web && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/login.html'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist/login')) fs.mkdirSync('dist/login'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/login/index.html');"
